say:1:1621104001:1.text: Lately, shops on Holt Street have been closing one after another, and none of them leave so much as a note.
say:1:1621104001:1.source_cn: 最近，霍尔特商业街陆续有店铺关门，连一纸公告都没留。

say:3:1621104003:1.male: What's strange is that the street is more crowded than ever.
